On 2-3 Jun the IRGC launched drone and missile attacks on Kuwait's international airport and the US Fifth Fleet headquarters in Bahrain — retaliatory strikes following US self-defense strikes near Hormuz (CNN/Al Jazeera, 2026-06-03). forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a NEW concrete Iranian closure action between 2026-06-02 and 2026-06-09: fresh mine-laying, a formally declared total-closure/exclusion order, or a new IRGC seizure/attack on a commercial vessel.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + a US/UK maritime authority (NAVCENT/UKMTO) advisory.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Repetition of existing warnings or continuation of de facto closure within the previously charted minefield perimeter (as of 2026-06-01) does NOT count; a single unverified state-media claim without corroboration = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Fresh mine-laying counts only if NAVCENT or UKMTO confirms activity outside the previously charted minefield extent. Incremental additional mine-laying within the existing charted perimeter does not independently satisfy resolution. IRGC attack on a commercial vessel resolves YES only if confirmed by two TIER1 sources.
